## Outcome

What behavior changed, and which issue does this address?

## Acceptance criteria

Link the issue and map completed criteria to tests or explicit manual evidence.

## Test-first evidence

- Red: failing case and observed reason.
- Green: focused passing command/result.
- Refactor: changes made while green, if any.
- Integration/browser/live checks relevant to the change.

## Limitations

State unverified providers, unsupported session modes, or skipped device checks. Do not claim live checks from mocks.
